description: This file defines the class HTMLPurifier_Arborize, which provides static methods to transform a stream of HTML tokens into a node tree (arborize) and to flatten a node tree into tokens. It is part of the HTMLPurifier library, handling internal representations of HTML documents.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_Arborize
classes.description: A utility class for transforming between token streams and node trees within the HTMLPurifier library.

methods.name: arborize
methods.description: Transforms a token stream into a node tree by nesting nodes according to start/end tokens.

methods.name: flatten
methods.description: Flattens a node tree into a token stream for serialization or further processing.
